The main takeaway from our work is that
the most compact and efficient narrow-linewidth lasers, frequency combs, and comb-based sources for mass production can be achieved by using ordinary laser diodes.
the most compact and cost-effective frequency comb sources, as well as comb-based devices, can be realized by using ordinary broadband laser diodes.
